state.background: Review proposed P42-599 migration before implementation. In tests/e2e/tooltip-stack-total.e2e.spec.ts T9, proposed removal is only `expect(tooltip.locator('data-tooltip-row true')).toHaveCount(12)` at approximately line 149. The existing tests/components/CustomTooltip.test.tsx case `renders all CPI categories in category/color/order contract and sums finite values only` tests supplied CustomTooltip props and asserts rows length equals CPI_CATEGORIES.length; keys, order metadata, palette colors, zero and missing/NaN dash handling, and total containing 1.25. A separate existing test pins CPI_CATEGORIES.length to 12 and stackedColors same length. This is a component data contract and does not establish real app route/Recharts payload wiring. Retain P42-593..598 in Playwright: visible chart, actual area paths, viewport, positive in-viewport path bounding box, real hover, live tooltip visible, and live total DOM visibility. In particular keep P42-598 total visible because the component fixture does not prove the route renders that total. The three plan docs propose removing only the row count after JEV approval, map it to the existing test, and preserve live chart/hit/payload evidence. No test/source implementation change has occurred yet; this is a plan decision only.
acceptanceCriteria: The 12-row count is equivalently covered at the CustomTooltip supplied-props component boundary, including explicit pin that CPI category count is 12.
The unit test is not misrepresented as proving live route or Recharts payload wiring.
Only P42-599 is proposed for removal; P42-593..598 remain browser-side including visible total.
The plan, callsite ledger, and responsibility matrix consistently express scope and test ownership.
